assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.

Exterior entrance door heights (south, west) assumed 2.7m pending elevation confirmation.

input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound view_image returns are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.

room_use_review.next_action: Use-basis records saved; unresolved inferences remain explicit.
room_use_review.interpretation: Counts cover structured role_evidence only, not semantic correctness. Legacy source_refs may contain other evidence. Unknown remains a fallback when no defensible listed use fits; it is not a preferred response to ambiguity.

decision.reason: Matches North_view.png dimension chain for 1F window family; resolved z=[1,2.6] matches declared value.

claims.reason: North_view.png (and matching South/East elevations) show the 1F window family with a vertical dimension chain from ground: 1000mm sill, 1600mm window height, 400mm lintel to the 3000mm floor-to-floor line. Segment index 1 (zero-based) of this chain gives the window's absolute z extent on F1 (z_floor=0).

decision.reason: Matches North_view.png dimension chain for 2F window family; resolved z=[4,5.8] matches declared value.

claims.reason: North_view.png (and matching South/East/West elevations) show the 2F window family with a vertical dimension chain from the 2F floor line (3000mm absolute): 1000mm sill, 1800mm window height, 800mm lintel to the roof/parapet line. Segment index 1 (zero-based) of this chain, with origin at the 2F floor level (3.0m absolute), gives the window's absolute z extent on F2 (z_floor=3.0).

decision.reason: South_view.png and West_view.png both confirm the 1F glazed entrance doors span the full 3000mm story height, not the previously assumed 2.7m.

claims.reason: South_view.png shows the glazed entrance door (with transom lights) spanning a full 3000mm from ground to the 1F floor-to-floor line (600+900+1500=3000mm chain). West_view.png confirms the same double-door bay spans the full 3000mm 1F story height (two stacked '3000' dimension ticks, ground to floor line). Both exterior 1F entrance doors are therefore full-height glazed frames, z=[0,3.0].

after: Exterior entrance door heights (south, west) confirmed at z=[0,3.0] via South_view.png/West_view.png dimension chains. Interior corridor/room door heights (2.1m) remain an explicit assumption; no plan or elevation dimension exists for them.
superseded_notes.before: Interior door and exterior entrance door heights not yet cross-checked against elevation drawings.
superseded_notes.reason: South_view.png and West_view.png entrance door dimension chains examined and applied; interior door heights remain genuinely unobserved.

current_claim_state.note: Current numerical/context consistency only; neither retained nor confirmed means drawing truth.

height_coverage.note: Coverage means a current adopted z binding, not proof that the drawing or BIM is correct. Inference and declared values do not count as located-image height evidence.
